title: Sweetened Condensed Milk Caramel
description: Make sweetened condensed milk into caramel in just one easy step with this recipe. Just boil right in the can and presto chango—caramel sauce.

steps.text: Place unopened can of sweetened condensed milk in a large pot; fill pot with water to cover. Simmer gently for 3 hours, adding hot water as needed to keep the can fully submerged at all times to prevent bursting. Remove can from water with tongs; allow to cool completely before opening to prevent splattering.

video.description: Turn sweetened condensed milk into caramel with this recipe. Yes, it's true — caramel sauce can be this easy. In this video we show you how to transform sweetened condensed milk into caramel in just one easy step. Just boil right in the can and presto chango — caramel sauce. And with the convenience of an Instant Pot, it couldn't get any easier. You don't even have to open the can to cook it! Delicious.
